source.title: Warhammer 40,000: The App 2.8.0, data build 981, released 2026-10-14

data.summary:
This unit is a valid target for the **[Heroic Intervention](vsdata:core-rule/heroic-intervention)** Stratagem whatever other uses it has had this phase. When you target it this way:

- that use costs 1 CP less
- other units can still receive the Stratagem in this phase
- if an engaged **PSYKER** unit of yours is up to 12" away as this unit declares the charge that use allows, you may use the rest of this ability

When you do, this unit:

- may re-roll the Charge roll
- must finish the Charge move engaged with any enemy unit already engaged with that **PSYKER** unit

charge.trigger: owner unit declares the charge granted by that Heroic Intervention use while a friendly engaged PSYKER unit is within range
charge.mustEndChargeMoveEngagedWith: an enemy unit engaged with that friendly PSYKER unit
